# Route reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run sync:api-reference` from docs/api/routes.json.
     Do not edit: `npm run check:api-reference` rejects a hand-edited copy.

Every route this service serves, read from the composed Express app rather than
from the source. 358 public and 95 operations routes.

For what an endpoint *does*, read the hand-written section for its feature:
[admin](./01-admin.md), [auth](./02-auth.md), [account](./03-account.md),
[guest checkout](./04-guest-checkout.md), [contact and chat](./05-contact-chat.md),
[gallery](./06-gallery.md), [operations](./07-operation.md), [gift](./08-gift.md).
